검지기로 교통량 · 점유율 · 통행시간 측정하기Measure flow, occupancy, and travel time with detectors

한 링크에 세 종류의 검지기를 설치합니다. 차로마다 설치한 E1으로 교통량을, 한 차로에 설치한 E2로 점유율을, 링크 전체를 감싸는 E3로 통행시간을 1분 단위로 측정합니다.Put all three detector types on one link: E1 per lane for flow, E2 over one lane for occupancy, and E3 around the link for travel time, per minute.

add_detector_e1add_detector_e2add_detector_e3sim_stepflush_recordingsget_detector_flowget_detector_occupancyget_detector_mean_travel_timeget_link_lengthget_link_lane_count
시작하기 전에 NextCI 시작하기의 준비 세 단계를 마치고, SimulationInput/config.txt에 network=bucheon이 지정되어 있는지 확인하세요(네트워크 폴더: SimulationInput/networks/bucheon/).Before you start: finish the three setup steps in NextCI getting started, and make sure SimulationInput/config.txt says network=bucheon (network folder SimulationInput/networks/bucheon/).

NextCI/examples/tutorials/t2_detectors.py

전체 예제 코드Full example code
"""Tutorial 2: measure flow, occupancy, and travel time with E1, E2, and E3 detectors."""
from nextci import NextCIClient

LINK = 20001453                          # 3 lanes, 243.9 m in the example network bucheon

with NextCIClient().launch_and_connect() as client:
    length = client.get_link_length(LINK)
    lanes = client.get_link_lane_count(LINK)

    # E1 at the middle of every lane, E2 over lane 1, E3 around the whole link
    for lane in range(lanes):
        client.add_detector_e1(detector_id=f"e1_{lane}", link_id=LINK,
                               lane_index=lane, pos=length / 2, freq=60.0)
    client.add_detector_e2(detector_id="e2_lane1", link_id=LINK, lane_index=1,
                           pos=10.0, end_pos=length - 10.0, freq=60.0)
    client.add_detector_e3(
        detector_id="e3_link",
        entries=",".join(f"{LINK}:{lane}:5.0" for lane in range(lanes)),
        exits=",".join(f"{LINK}:{lane}:{length - 5:.1f}" for lane in range(lanes)),
        freq=60.0,
    )

    client.sim_step(3000)                # 5 min warm-up
    print("time_s  flow_veh_h lane0/1/2   occupancy_%  travel_time_s")
    for _ in range(5):
        client.sim_step(600)             # 60 s = the detectors' aggregation interval
        client.flush_recordings()        # interval values update after a flush
        flows = [client.get_detector_flow(f"e1_{lane}") for lane in range(lanes)]
        print(f"{client.get_sim_time_millis() / 1000:6.0f}  {flows!s:22}  "
              f"{client.get_detector_occupancy('e2_lane1'):10.1f}  "
              f"{client.get_detector_mean_travel_time('e3_link'):12.1f}")

실행Run

python3 NextCI/examples/tutorials/t2_detectors.py

예시 출력Example output

time_s  flow_veh_h lane0/1/2   occupancy_%  travel_time_s
   360  [60.0, 180.0, 0.0]             6.1         196.6
   420  [300.0, 0.0, 0.0]              7.2         187.8
   480  [0.0, 120.0, 0.0]              1.7         196.2
   540  [300.0, 240.0, 0.0]            3.1         286.5
   600  [60.0, 480.0, 0.0]            26.2          57.4

살펴볼 점What to notice

  • 검지기의 freq=60.0과 스텝 간격 60초를 맞추면, 반복할 때마다 새 구간이 하나씩 끝납니다.With the detectors' freq=60.0 matching the 60 s step, each loop closes exactly one interval.
  • 구간 값은 flush_recordings()를 호출한 뒤에 갱신됩니다. 호출하지 않으면 이전 구간 값을 받거나 No detector interval record yet 오류가 발생합니다.Interval values update after flush_recordings(); without it you get the previous interval or No detector interval record yet.
  • 점유율은 E2에서만, 통행시간은 E3에서만 값이 채워집니다. E1 검지기에 get_detector_occupancy()를 호출하면 0이 반환됩니다.Occupancy is filled only by E2 and travel time only by E3; get_detector_occupancy() on an E1 returns 0.
  • 교통량 300 veh/h는 60초 동안 차량 5대가 지나갔다는 뜻입니다.A flow of 300 veh/h means 5 vehicles passed in 60 s.
